blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Mary Jane Veloso, who has reclaimed her freedom after being given pardon by President Marcos last week, is pushing through with the criminal cases she filed against her illegal recruiters to clear her name. Veloso, who came to the Department of Justice (DOJ) press conference on Thursday, said that she wants her former recruiters to exonerate her after being dragged into drug trafficking, a case for which she was convicted of and put on death row for in Indonesia. “I suppose my only message to them is that I hope they themselves would acknowledge that I am not […]...
